fact: The ISIE says that from 13 November 2023 voters can check their registration at voting centres and constituencies via service 195 with the national ID card number, and by SMS, with 1.406 million Tunisians having used SMS to check their polling place.

Organic law 2014-16 (art. 13) says the electoral lists are made available to the public at the electoral body's premises, municipal seats and consulates abroad and are published on the body's website, and art. 7 says voters consult the registers and ask for updates.
